title: Integrated Design and Governance of Agentic AI Systems through Adaptive Information Modulation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the governance of multi-agent systems using LLMs to solve social dilemmas like the Prisoner's Dilemma. While it aims to promote 'pro-social behavior' and maximize 'social welfare,' it treats these as engineering objectives and game-theoretic outcomes rather than evaluating religion, theology, or formal ethical/moral reasoning systems.
